links.outcome: LLM diagnostic recall on admission-time evidence, especially inference-dependent diagnoses
links.effect: Zero-shot models recover only 3-31% of diagnoses that must be inferred; post-training raises inference-dependent recall to 56%; no system attains a clinician's balance of sensitivity and precision on time-critical conditions.
links.quote: Zero-shot models score largely by extraction, recovering only 3-31% of diagnoses that must be inferred rather than read from the record; post-training raises inference-dependent recall to 56%, but a sizeable margin remains, and on time-critical conditions no system attains a clinician's balance of sensitivity and precision.

unlisted_practices: Admission-time-anchored benchmark construction with LLM auditor verifying evidence support of free-text labels

screen.reason: The study introduces and evaluates LLMs on EarlyDx, an admission-anchored diagnostic generation benchmark derived from MIMIC-IV data, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
